questions.prompt: What is the plan mainly about?
options: Making all English farms sell food online.
Helping English farms produce and sell more organic food.
Moving organic food sales from shops to farms.
Opening more restaurants on English organic farms.
questions.explanationZh: 计划的核心是帮助英格兰的农场增加有机食品的生产和销售，让商店和餐馆有更多选择。文章没有说所有农场都要网上销售、改在农场销售或开餐馆。
questions.promptZh: 这项计划主要涉及什么？

questions.prompt: Which farmers can get advice and support?
options: Only farmers who already sell food to restaurants.
Only farmers who are starting their first business.
Farmers who want to stop producing organic food.
Organic farmers and farmers thinking about a change.
questions.explanationZh: 第3句同时提到已经生产有机食品的农民和正在考虑转变的农民，第4句说明这些农民可以获得建议与支持。
questions.promptZh: 哪些农民可以获得建议和支持？

questions.prompt: What does the plan say about organic farmland?
options: The aim is to move towards 10% by 2036.
The share has already reached 10% in England.
The aim is to move towards 3.4% by 2036.
The share will stay at 3.4% until 2036.
questions.explanationZh: 公告中的现状约为3.4%，到2036年朝10%迈进是未来目标。第11句明确说，这不表示变化已经发生。
questions.promptZh: 这项计划对有机耕地怎么说？
